synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis (wall band, x=row) + holed 3x3-block pieces + gray reflections (block row 2A-r for piece blocks off the axis, skipping piece blocks) + yellow targets; layered render piece>refl>target>wall, then re-extract by colour (wall/player comps over own+all 0 cells, ranked by bbox).
ACTION1-4 move the selection: the axis moves by rows only; a piece moves one block at a time, blocked by bounds and by other pieces.
Missed mechanic (step 64): ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces in INTRINSIC order (largest piece first, then by min block), not by position; no selection -> axis. Sorting by position fails only step 64.
The target A3 mixed-outcome hypothesis is a red herring: those are occlusion and re-ranking effects (clicks never occur). The program passes 33/33 with hidden state on and with it disabled.
Unconfirmed: piece-vs-piece blocking, tie order for equal-size pieces, and what A5 does after the last piece (assumed back to axis).
